title: 午夜博物馆(状态机示例)
player_appearance: a slender figure in a charcoal tailcoat and white half-mask, leather gloves and a flat cap, a coil of rope over one shoulder
scene_description: a grand museum hall after midnight, moonlight through a glass ceiling, marble statues under velvet ropes, a gilded vault door at the far end
style: 3D CG, cinematic, heist thriller night, cool moonlight with warm torch accents
camera: The camera stays a locked-off static medium-wide shot with no pan, no zoom and no cut; the thief keeps to the center of the hall and only small precise movements play
soundscape: a distant clock ticks, the HVAC breathes through vents, glass and marble hold the silence
music: Sparse pizzicato strings and a brushed snare at a creeping tempo.

hall.label: 展厅
hall.action: moves between the display plinths, reading the placards by moonlight
hall.end_state: pauses at the hall's center, eyes on the gilded vault door

vault_door.label: 金库门前
vault_door.action: crouches at the gilded vault door, feeling the dial's edge with gloved fingers
vault_door.end_state: leans close to the dial, ear pressed to the cold gilt
effects: torchlight guttering across the gilt hinges

vault.label: 金库内部
vault.action: slips inside the vault, shelves of artifacts glinting under a single red lamp
vault.end_state: stands amid the shelves, satchel open and ready
effects: a red emergency lamp glowing steady

actions.label: 调查展柜
actions.phrase: kneels at a display case, lifting the velvet rope aside to study the placard, then rises with a small nod

actions.label: 潜行到金库门前
actions.description: 贴墙移动,可能引起警觉
actions.phrase: hugs the wall and slides between the statues, each step placed with exaggerated care
effects: a long shadow sliding across the marble floor

actions.label: 撬动转盘
actions.description: 尝试打开金库(可能失败并增加警觉)
actions.phrase: works the vault dial in slow increments, feeling for the tumbler clicks through the gloves
effects: sweat beading under the mask edge

actions.label: 取走珍品
actions.phrase: lifts the prized artifact from its shelf and settles it into the satchel with practiced care
effects: the artifact catching the red lamp light

actions.label: 伏低躲避
actions.phrase: melts into the shadow behind a statue, going perfectly still until the moment passes
effects: deep shadow swallowing the figure's outline

events.message: 找到了一条关于金库的线索
脚步声在空旷的大厅里回响,警觉上升
转盘卡住了,金属声在门后荡开

won.action: slips back out through the moonlit hall with the satchel full, tips an imaginary hat to the marble statues, and vanishes through the glass ceiling's reflection
effects: moonlight blazing off the satchel's buckle
won.end_state: the hall stands empty, only dust settling in the moonbeam
won.caption: ◆ 完美得手 ◆

lost.action: freezes as searchlight beams sweep the hall from two directions, then raises gloved hands slowly as guards close in
lost.end_state: the thief kneels in the crossed beams, the vault door still sealed
lost.caption: ◆ 行动败露 ◆
